svg.title: DNP3-EXTRA selected PDF requirement progress
svg.desc: 69 Profile objects and functions, 36 security parameters, and 14 selected runtime configuration groups. 119 individual status tiles. Based on historical source reviews, not current acceptance.

g.text: Every selected object, parameter and configuration group
12-page RTU Device Profile + 6-page minimum security addendum
G0-G122 and function-only cases: full FC / Q in linked inventory

g.text: SA v5, TLS, keys, users, RTU hardening

g.title: SEC-T1-01 / Secure Authentication: Fixed: Version 5 | Mandatory, no false reporting / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T1-02 / Maximum users: Configurable, at least 2 | Mandatory / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-03 / Security response timeout: Configurable, 0-120 s | Mandatory range; legal zero semantics to verify in IEEE / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T1-04 / Aggressive receive: Yes, not recommended | Capability required; usage policy separate / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-05 / Aggressive issue: Yes, not recommended | Capability required; usage policy separate / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-06 / Challenge-response: Mandatory | Mandatory / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-07 / Session key change interval: Configurable, 15-120 min | Mandatory / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED
SEC-T1-08 / Session key change count: Configurable, default 1000 messages | Mandatory / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-09 / Requested MAC: Selectable SHA-256 (16/8 octets), AES-GMAC | Final required *selection set* not filled by checkboxes; track separately / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T1-10 / Session key wrapping: AES-256 mandatory; AES-128 not recommended | Mandatory AES-256 / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-11 / TLS cipher suites: TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 lists | Conflicting TLS 1.3 naming; clarify before coding / historical status: BLOCKED
SEC-T1-12 / DNP TCP port using TLS: Fixed: 19999 | Mandatory when using TLS / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T1-13 / Cipher-change request timeout: Configurable, 1-60 s | Mandatory / historical status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
SEC-T1-14 / Supported CAs: At least 4 | Mandatory / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED
SEC-T1-15 / Certificate revocation check time: Configurable; numeric value blank | OPEN: no default/range supplied / historical status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
SEC-T1-16 / Remote update-key changes: Configurable, symmetric/asymmetric algorithm options | Must distinguish alternatives vs minimum mandatory options / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T1-17 / User-credential expiry: Yes | Mandatory / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-01 / Protocol authentication: Challenge-response; Aggressive Mode not recommended / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-02 / Protected communications: TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-03 / Session-key encryption and exchange: Key wrap / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-04 / Update-key protection: Symmetric and asymmetric approaches indicated; must agree on operative choice / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T2-05 / Session key length: 128-bit acceptable; 256-bit recommended / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-06 / Update key length: 128-bit acceptable; 256-bit recommended / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-07 / Local RTU configuration password: Mandatory / historical status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
SEC-T2-08 / Random generation for security keys: Mandatory / historical status: VERIFIED
SEC-T2-09 / Authentication enabled by default: Mandatory; disabling for protocol configuration accepted (as described) / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T2-10 / Minimum user roles: Administrator for security settings, ordinary user for technical settings; both may perform ordinary tasks / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T2-11 / Security parameter configurability: Mandatory for all protocol/configuration security parameters / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T3-01 / Close unused hardware ports: Mandatory / historical status: NOT_AUDITED
SEC-T3-02 / Close unused network ports: Mandatory / historical status: NOT_AUDITED
SEC-T3-03 / Disable unnecessary users: Mandatory / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T3-04 / Strong passwords for human users: Mandatory strong passwords (security PDF p6 Table 3 row 4) / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T3-05 / Do not hardcode credentials: Mandatory / historical status: PARTIAL
SEC-T3-06 / Hash stored credentials: Mandatory / historical status: NOT_AUDITED
SEC-T3-07 / Secure firmware update with digital-signature verification: Recommended / historical status: NOT_AUDITED
SEC-T3-08 / Check digital signature during firmware update: Recommended / historical status: NOT_AUDITED

g.text: All selected CFG groups, including compound parameter selections

g.title: CFG-01 / Level 3 Outstation and explicitly listed extensions. Identify vendor/device metadata left blank in the form without fabricating values. / historical status: PARTIAL
CFG-02 / Link receive frame size must be 292 octets. Transmit size is blank. Document the product value and verify frame boundaries. / historical status: PARTIAL

CFG-03 / Application receive fragment size must exceed 249 octets. Transmit size above 2048 must be configurable. Both size fields are blank. Verify configured bounds, segmentation, reassembly and resource limits. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED

CFG-04 / Link retries configurable 0-5. Application retries configurable 1-5, fixed retries disallowed. Test limits, exhaustion and reconnect while respecting IEEE function-specific retry prohibitions, including direct controls. / historical status: PARTIAL
CFG-05 / Link confirmation configurable as Never, Always or On multi-frame fragments. Exercise each permitted policy. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED
CFG-06 / Application confirmation selected for event data and multi-fragment responses. Verify CONFIRM ownership, timeout, retry and event retention. / historical status: PARTIAL

CFG-07 / Configurable waits for link confirm, complete application fragment, application confirm and complete application response. Numeric ranges/defaults and explanatory attachment are absent. Resolve role applicability and test approved values and boundaries. / historical status: PARTIAL

CFG-08 / SELECT/OPERATE, DIRECT OPERATE and DIRECT OPERATE NO ACK selected Always. Verify execution, denial and no-response semantics with selected G12/G41 wire forms and SA policy. Compatibility-only FC6 evidence does not close authenticated control acceptance. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED

CFG-09 / WRITE Binary Outputs, Count > 1, Pulse On/Off, Latch On/Off, Queue and Clear Queue selected Never. Trip/Close selected Always. Resolve the exact IEEE field/operation mapping and verify the production control policy and rejected forms. Preserve reusable library capabilities. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED

CFG-10 / Default binary change events are Only time-tagged. Absolute-time form and Configurable are both selected for default timed events. Verify actual default variation and obtain the missing configuration explanation. / historical status: PARTIAL

CFG-11 / Unsolicited responses configurable and ENABLE/DISABLE UNSOLICITED supported. Verify enable/disable, startup, event delivery, confirmations and retry behavior. Configuration explanation is absent. / historical status: PARTIAL

CFG-12 / Static unsolicited data selected When Device Restarts, with other options unselected. Resolve the exact IEEE-compatible startup sequence and static-data delivery requirement. Test real restart integration separately from a startup null unsolicited response. / historical status: BLOCKED

CFG-13 / No Counters Reported selected for both counter defaults and rollover. Production configuration must report no physical counter points. General Level 4 G20-G23 implementation is outside this target. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED

CFG-14 / Multi-fragment responses selected Yes. Test selected data families across fragments, sequence progression, confirmations and malformed/incomplete transfers. / historical status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED

g.text: Prior VERIFIED means historical evidence only. Each selected FC/Q, parameter choice, boundary and test case must be reconciled.
Per-ID full details: DNP3_PDF_COVERAGE.md / CSV. G70 extension is outside the 119-PDF-ID denominator.
